<!-- pr-reviewer: f6385d82c2f8aca08012588aad379577c42faed4 -->
**Verdict: Needs a merge with main before it can merge (CONFLICTING). The code itself is clean on the PR head; no safety blockers found.**

## Merge conflict
One conflict against current `origin/main`: `crates/cl/src/cl/mod.rs` line ~32. This PR adds `mod rotary;` and main added `pub mod text;` in the same spot. Keep both lines. Everything else merged automatically (it also touched `crates/sim/tests/stock_sim.rs` cleanly). Because it is a code file I did not resolve it; the results below are the PR head as pushed, **not** merged with main. Please `git merge origin/main`, keep both `mod` lines, and re-run the quick gate.

## What looks good
- `cl::stamp_c` (cl/rotary.rs): the split bound compares the machine's X(radius)/Z/C-linear point against the chord at the same parameter t (quarter points) - a pointwise gap is never smaller than the geometric distance to the chord, so the bound is conservative. A move that passes the spindle line (r small, C swings ~180) shows a huge gap at t=0.5, bisects to depth 12, then is refused by name ("passes too near the spindle line"). Arcs, no-pose, off-station pose, and cycle/comp/thread/probe records are all refused by name.
- C is unwrapped per move against the previous one (`unwrap_near`); the machine C-travel check (`machine/mod.rs c_letter_problem`) refuses an angle outside the stated -360..360 and a missing C axis, so multi-ring paths are refused, not emitted.
- Rapids as G01 at the machine's stated max feed, never G00: correct and the safer choice - a G00 with C interpolates each axis independently (non-linear path) and nothing verified that. Missing max feed is refused by name (fanuc-lathe.cps liveMove).
- Post turns each tip by C and refuses (never projects) a move that does not land on the +X station within 5 um; first move must be a rapid; A/B words refused in a C section; arcs and cycles refused.
- Every mill post refuses `PARAM LiveTool` by name (engine.rs, `voices_live_tooling`; test `every_post_without_c_or_without_the_machines_words_refuses_by_name`); the lathe post refuses without all four `tool_station.live_tool` words (all-or-none parse), and `shipped millturn.mch` states none, so in-app posting refuses until the user adds them.
- Byte-identity when no C: `rotary` is `None` everywhere else, `MoveDto.rotary` skips serialization, and `dump` emits the PARAM only when some move states C; the `the_c_word_rides_the_stream_and_parses_back` test pins it. All existing goldens pass unchanged.
- No unwrap/expect/panic in non-test code in the diff; provenance lines present; decision file `docs/decisions/33-continuous-c.md`; no CHANGELOG/RECOMMENDED edits; no build.rs, scripts, workflow or dependency changes. `.cps` length is exempt; `post/mod.rs` 465 -> ~481 was already over (note only).

## Local results (PR head, NOT merged with main because of the conflict)
| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| build `-p cl post app sim motion ui --no-run` | ok |
| cl lib (incl. `cl::rotary`) | 29 passed |
| post: comp / post_engine | 6 / 31 passed |
| app: c_axis_live | 4 passed |
| app: rotary_letter | 3 passed |
| app lib `rotary` (incl. `rotary_gate`) / `machine` | 5 / 1 passed |
| app: machine | 32 passed |
| app: rotary_verify / rotary_fixtures | 9 / 4 passed |
| sim: stock_rotary / overhang_laws / stock_lathe / stock_posed | 2 / 13 / 7 / 3 passed |
| motion lib `machining3d` | 4 passed |
| ui (CWD crates/ui): trace_parity | 5 passed |
| `cargo clippy` on the six crates, `--all-targets -D warnings` | clean |

## Requested before merge
1. Resolve the conflict in `crates/cl/src/cl/mod.rs` (keep `mod rotary;` and `pub mod text;`), re-gate quick, push.

## Questions / notes (not blocking)
1. Split pieces keep the parent move's `axis` (`..*m` in `rotary.rs` `split`), which is the radial axis at the move's END. For a 30 deg chord split into 8 pieces, the first piece still carries the end-of-chord pose though the machine's radial tool stands ~4 deg from its start. Round-nose tools are unaffected; for a flat radial tool the verifier sees a pose up to the chord angle off the machine's true one. Consider stamping each piece with its own radial axis (`[cos phi, sin phi, 0]` at the piece end). The issue exists today for unsplit rotary paths, so I did not treat it as a blocker.
2. Feed: `F = f * lcmd / ltrue` can exceed the machine's stated max feed for a rapid when the C degrees dominate (golden shows ~2370 for a 400 mm/min cut). The control clamps or alarms; consider clamping to `feedRateMax` or noting it.
3. "Degrees as mm" composite feed: this matches how Fanuc-style controls are generally documented for combined linear+rotary moves (rotary deg treated as the linear unit for the composite rate), but I could not verify it against a specific control manual; the PR already flags it as an assumption to confirm on a real control. Also note X is programmed as diameter while `lcmd` uses the radius; plausible (feed is on the radial travel), same caveat.
4. `TiltedFrame::world_path` (cl/frame.rs) builds moves with `rotary: None`. It only feeds the hardware-law walk in `generate.rs` ~2931 (the posted path is the local one), so C is not lost in the post, but a C op on a tilted setup would be law-checked without its C stamp. Probably fine for a spindle-line rotary; worth a test if that combination is reachable.
5. `finish_clip.rs` `runs` also drops `rotary` when clipping; only reachable for Finish 3D, not the rotary kinds that stamp, so nothing is lost today.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

<!-- pr-reviewer: 9b2e3e2ebbf5ddd48d9a3ebfb8c782c8e87f361d -->
**Ready for the maintainer to merge** (re-review at 9b2e3e2; scope: the delta since f6385d8)

**What looks good**
- Trial merge with current origin/main is clean (no conflicts). `crates/cl/src/cl/mod.rs` keeps both `mod rotary;` and `pub mod text;`, plus the `stamp_c`/`unwrap_near` re-export; nothing from either side lost.
- The PR's own diff vs main touches no `build.rs`, `.github/`, scripts or Cargo files, so it was built.
- `rotary: None` is added at every `Move` literal main gained (frame.rs, cl_read, the sim tests stock_dual / hidden_rest_banded / stock_lathe_blade and others). It compiles and the tests pass.
- The app golden writer emits the stated C as a separate `SC` word (tests/common/mod.rs:171), so C-axis live cuts get their own golden words. Every existing golden stays byte-identical because `rotary` is None there.

**Local results (merged with main)**
| check | result |
|---|---|
| cl lib + headless_bin | 29 + 3 passed |
| sim stock_dual, stock_lathe_blade, hidden_rest_banded, stock_rotary, headless_bin | 3, 5, 5, 5, 2 passed (1 ignored: pre-existing) |
| app c_axis_live, rotary_letter, rotary_verify, machine, golden_cl | 4, 23, 32, 3, 9 passed |
| post (lib/engine suites) | all passed |
| clippy -D warnings (cl, sim, post, motion, app, all-targets) | clean |

**Requested before merge**
None.

**Questions / notes (not blocking; the earlier notes stand)**
1. `cl::text::to_text` (crates/cl/src/cl/text.rs:52-111) silently drops `Move::rotary`. It writes only to/feed/arc/A-B-C pose. `Toolpath::is_prismatic` (crates/cl/src/cl/path.rs:107) also ignores `rotary`, so a C-live path with a vertical axis would be dumped as v1 with no C. `from_text` would then reject the app's `SC` word as "unknown word", which is loud, but a headless `camcraft-sim` run on a rotary-stripped dump would simulate without the part turning.
   - Today this is unreachable: the only `to_text` caller, `camcraft-motion`, generates `face` paths, which never carry `rotary`. It is a latent gap.
   - Suggest a follow-up issue: either have `to_text` return `Err` when any move has `rotary` (refuse by name), or add an `SC` word to the writer and reader to match the golden grammar.
2. `TiltedFrame` (crates/cl/src/cl/frame.rs:197-311) rebuilds moves with `rotary: None`. This is fine while C-live is only emitted on the unrotated setup frame. If a tilted setup ever combines with C-live, the frame would drop C silently. Worth a one-line note or assert in the decision doc (docs/decisions/33-continuous-c.md).
3. The other main work (#280 dual contouring, #282 banded scan, #285 wasm, #275 comp posts, #200 lathe blade) only needed the `rotary: None` field additions. I found no interaction beyond that.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
